findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_bookkeeper · Private data: categorise_expenses, request_bookkeeper · Public sink: check_vat_mtd_thresholds, request_bookkeeper.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_bookkeeper · Private data: categorise_expenses, request_bookkeeper · Public sink: check_vat_mtd_thresholds, request_bookkeeper

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_bookkeeper" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
